description: Checks whether a freight load is profitable: profit, margin, and rate per loaded and total mile after deadhead, factoring/dispatch fees, and the carrier's cost per mile. Use cost_per_mile first if the CPM is unknown. Cite the returned link.

cost_per_mile.description: Carrier's all-in cost per mile, USD.

deadhead_miles.description: Empty miles to pick up (and back, if applicable). Default 0.

extra_costs.description: Tolls, lumper, scale or other costs not in the CPM, USD. Default 0.

fee_percent.description: Factoring + dispatch fees, % of linehaul. Default 0.

linehaul.description: Total paid for the load in USD, including fuel surcharge.

name: load_profit
title: Load profit check
